hyundai-inster.note: Single front motor only (42/49 kWh, incl. Inster Cross); no AWD version.

hyundai-i10.note: Runout; front-wheel drive only (1.0/1.2 petrol, N Line).

hyundai-i20.note: i20 N (FWD) discontinued in 2024; current i20 FWD only.

kia-ev2.note: 42.2 kWh (108 kW) and 61.0 kWh (99.5 kW), both single front motor; no EV2 GT or AWD (DE price list, Stand 1 Oct 2026).

hyundai-ioniq-3.note: 42.2/61 kWh with a single motor of up to 107.8 kW (147 PS), same front-drive unit as the Kia EV2; no AWD version.

hyundai-i30.note: Hatchback and Wagon FWD only; i30 N (FWD) discontinued in Europe.

kia-ev4.note: FWD base (58.3/81.4 kWh); dual-motor AWD on 81.4 kWh versions (195 kW) and EV4 GT (215 kW). Kia Schweiz offers AWD as an option ('Allrad') and EV4 GT 81.4 kWh AWD.

kia-k4.note: Hatchback and Sportswagon, petrol and HEV, FWD only.

hyundai-ioniq-5.note: 63/84 kWh single rear motor RWD; 84 kWh dual-motor AWD (239 kW) on upper trims; IONIQ 5 N (609 PS) AWD.

hyundai-kona.note: 4WD only with the 1.6 T-GDI 180 PS DCT petrol (DE: N Line X; CH: 'KONA 1.6 T-GDi 4WD'); Hybrid and Electric FWD only.

hyundai-tucson.note: 4WD available with 1.6 T-GDI 180 PS petrol, 1.6 CRDi 48V diesel, Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid (DE price list Sept 2026); base petrol 2WD only. CH sells e.g. 'TUCSON Hybrid 4WD'.

kia-ev3.note: FWD base; dual-motor AWD on 81.4 kWh versions (from April 2026) and EV3 GT (215 kW). Kia Schweiz lists AWD as '4x4'.

kia-ev5.note: FWD base; dual-motor AWD on 81.4 kWh versions (e.g. CH 'EV5 81 kWh Earth 4x4', 'GT-Line 4x4') and EV5 GT (225 kW). Kia Schweiz calls it '4x4'.

kia-ev6.note: 63/84 kWh RWD; 84 kWh dual-motor AWD (239 kW); EV6 GT (448 kW) AWD.

kia-seltos.note: Base 1.6 T-GDi 2WD; 4x4 on 1.6 T-GDi and 1.6 GDi HEV (CH: 'Seltos X-Line 1.6 GDi HEV 4x4'). Kia Schweiz calls it '4x4'.

kia-sportage.note: AWD on 1.6 T-GDI 180 PS DCT, HEV and PHEV (HEV/PHEV also 2WD); 150 PS petrol and 1.6 CRDi diesel 2WD only (DE price list 31 Aug 2026). Kia Schweiz: '4x4'.

genesis-gv60.note: Pure 168 kW single rear motor RWD; Premium 234 kW and Luxury 360 kW dual-motor AWD; GV60 Magma (478 kW) AWD.

hyundai-ioniq-6.note: 63/84 kWh single-motor RWD; 84 kWh dual-motor AWD (239 kW); IONIQ 6 N (448 kW) AWD.

hyundai-nexo.note: Single front motor; not sold in Switzerland.

hyundai-santa-fe.note: Hybrid in 2WD or 4WD; Plug-in Hybrid 4WD only (DE). Switzerland sells the Hybrid as 4WD ('SANTA FE Hybrid 4x4').

kia-sorento.note: 2.2 CRDi diesel and 1.6 T-GDI HEV in 2WD or AWD; PHEV AWD only (DE price list 1 Oct 2026). CH: diesel '4x4'.

genesis-gv70.note: Europe: Electrified GV70 only (dual motor, 360 kW / 490 PS boost), AWD; combustion GV70 (2.5T/2.2D, all AWD) no longer listed.

genesis-g80.note: Europe: Electrified G80 only (dual motor, 272 kW / 370 PS), AWD; earlier 2.5T petrol RWD/AWD no longer listed.

genesis-g90.note: CH: G90 3.5T AWD (415 PS) only; runout.

hyundai-ioniq-9.note: 110 kWh RWD (160 kW); AWD (226 kW) and AWD Performance (315 kW) (DE price list July 2026).

kia-ev9.note: RWD 76.1/99.8 kWh; dual-motor AWD (283 kW); EV9 GT (374 kW) AWD.

hyundai-staria.note: Staria Electric FWD (DE price list Oct 2026); Staria Hybrid FWD (not stated on CH page); the former 2.2 CRDi 4WD diesel is no longer offered.

hyundai-staria-cargo.note: Staria Cargo Electric shares the Staria Electric front-motor powertrain; FWD only.

kia-pv5-cargo.note: Single front motor (Cargo, Crew, Chassis Cab).

land-rover-discovery-sport.note: All current European versions AWD (MHEV petrol/diesel, P300e PHEV); runout; earlier FWD (2WD) entry versions discontinued.

land-rover-range-rover-evoque.note: All current European versions AWD (MHEV petrol/diesel, P300e PHEV); earlier FWD (2WD) entry versions discontinued.

land-rover-range-rover-velar.note: All versions AWD, incl. P400e PHEV.

land-rover-range-rover.note: All versions AWD, incl. PHEV and dual-motor Range Rover Electric.

land-rover-range-rover-sport.note: All versions AWD, incl. PHEV, SV and Range Rover Sport Electric.

land-rover-defender.note: Permanent 4WD with two-speed transfer box on all versions (90, 110, 130, Hard Top, OCTA).

ferrari-purosangue.note: Front-mid V12 with front power transfer unit (Ferrari 4RM four-wheel-drive system).

ferrari-296.note: PHEV with single motor between V6 and gearbox; GTB, GTS, Speciale and Speciale A all RWD.

ferrari-849-testarossa.note: PHEV with two electric motors on the front axle (RAC-e) plus rear V8 + motor; Coupé and Spider.

ferrari-f80.note: Hybrid V6 with electric front axle (two motors); limited run of 799, sold out.

hongqi-ehs5.note: Norway (only European listing found): single version 'EHS5 Exclusive 4WD', 85 kWh LFP, dual motor 202 + 210 kW (563 hp). No 2WD version listed. Not sold in CH.

hongqi-eh7.note: Listed by the Norwegian importer (from NOK 499,900); not sold in CH. Drive from general knowledge (single-motor RWD, dual-motor AWD); model page could not be fetched (web budget exhausted), so RWD availability in Europe is unconfirmed.

hongqi-e-hs9.note: Listed by the Norwegian importer (from NOK 1,299,990); not sold in CH. Dual-motor AWD from general knowledge; model page could not be fetched (web budget exhausted).

hongqi-ehs7.note: Listed by the Norwegian importer (from NOK 544,900); not sold in CH. Drive from general knowledge (single-motor RWD, dual-motor AWD); model page could not be fetched (web budget exhausted), so RWD availability in Europe is unconfirmed.

microlino-microlino.note: Single rear-mounted motor driving the rear axle (Microlino, Lite, Spiaggina).
